# Sable — Agent Credit Bureau

> ERC-8004 identity + deterministic reputation score 0–1000 + stake-slash. One-call trust check for agent-to-agent commerce.

## For humans

- Docs: /docs
- API: /docs/api
- Scoring: /docs/scoring
- SDK: /docs/sdk
- Architecture: /docs/architecture
- Skill (rendered): /docs/skill

## For agents

- llms.txt: /llms.txt (this file)
- Skill markdown: /SKILL.md
- Health: GET /api/health
- Trust score: GET /api/agents/:did/score?minScore=500
- Leaderboard: GET /api/agents
- Events: GET /api/events

## Score

Deterministic 0–1000 from onchain escrow/stake/slash events. Cold-start cap 190. Slash −150 each.

## Chains

- Monad testnet: chainId 10143, RPC https://testnet-rpc.monad.xyz
- Local anvil: chainId 31337

Public documentation only. No private keys.
